skills.name: SQLMap GET assessment: Run a single-parameter GET check
skills.description: Perform an initial low-intensity assessment of one authorized query input.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm a stable, authorized GET request and retain its normal-response baseline.
2. Begin with app defaults: level 1, risk 1, technique BEU, one thread, and a short timeout.
3. Pass the approved URL, set `authorized_target=true`, select one parameter, and leave level/risk/technique/thread defaults unchanged.
4. Review the named parameter result; do not enumerate or retrieve database contents.

Safety: use web.sqlmap with uthorized_target=true only for owner-authorized scope. Do not dump records, open shells, access server files, evade controls, or perform destructive actions.
